note: Adapted from the species-level description in Hill (1942), original in English; the original combination is Mirotermes jarmuranus Hill, 1929 (the headline is OCR'd as Mirozermes (Mirot ernes)), now placed in Ekphysotermes. Distribution: 130 miles south-east of Broome, Western Australia (the checklist gives 208 km SE Broome). Known only from the type specimen (holotype dealated female, National Museum of Victoria). The original suggests that this species may be the same as M. broomensis, known only from the soldier. All measurements are of the dealated adult, in mm; the original expressly records the winged adult as "Not known", so no separate alate measurements are given.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: The original records the winged adult as "Not known"; only the dealated adult is described: a large, hirsute species, some of the hairs distinctly long. Head, thorax and abdominal tergites argus brown; legs, antennae and abdominal sternites buckthorn brown; clypeus ochraceous yellowish brown. Head (Fig. 299) subspherical in dorsal view. Frons concave. Frontal line linear. Compound eyes medium-sized, projecting. Ocelli large, broadly oval, inner margin distinctly raised, separated from the compound eye by slightly less than its short diameter. Antennae long, 15-segmented; segment 3 very long, not much shorter than segment 1; segment 2 very small; segments 4 and 5 long and narrow, shorter and narrower than segment 3, the remaining segments long. Apical tooth of mandibles far longer than and far removed from the next tooth. Postclypeus small, half as long as wide (0.25 × 0.50). Pronotum very large, distinctly wider than long, strongly arched, anterior margin distinctly concave, sides sloping to the broadly rounded posterior margin. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum narrow and deeply incised. Measurements (mm, dealated adult): body length without wings 6.15; head length (to apex of labrum) 1.32; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.74; head width 1.22; greatest diameter of compound eye 0.33; ocellus length 0.17; antennal length 2.28; pronotum length 0.77; pronotum width 1.19.
